"import cadquery as cq

# Build the sketch on the YZ plane (local u -> global +Y, v -> global +Z).
plane = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

def to_world(p):
    """Convert local sketch (u, v) coordinates to a global Vector via the YZ plane."""
    w = plane.toWorldCoords(p)
    # Older cadquery versions return a tuple/length-3 sequence; ensure a Vector.
    if not isinstance(w, cq.Vector):
        w = cq.Vector(*w)
    return w

# Five vertices, in order, that close into a single pentagon profile.
p1 = to_world(( 22.213486,  -3.737309))   # local u -> global y
p2 = to_world((  5.314143,   8.997259))
p3 = to_world((-12.019334,  -3.139773))
p4 = to_world(( -5.83267 , -23.375439))
p5 = to_world(( 15.324376, -23.744737))

# Exactly five line (curve) entities closing a single loop on the YZ plane.
edges = [
    cq.Edge.makeLine(p1, p2),
    cq.Edge.makeLine(p2, p3),
    cq.Edge.makeLine(p3, p4),
    cq.Edge.makeLine(p4, p5),
    cq.Edge.makeLine(p5, p1),
]

# Export the 5 edges as a compound to sketch.step in the current directory.
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
